Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 64

“But one who moves among objects with the senses under control, free of attraction and aversion and self-possessed, attains serenity.”

Krishna reverses the descent without asking for withdrawal. The senses still move among their objects; what changes is that they are being steered rather than dragged.
